content.title: The Novices
content.overview: Sister Agnès runs away from her convent in Brittany and seeks refuge in Paris with prostitute Mona Lisa. With absolutely no qualifications, the young novice has a hard job finding work, so Mona Lisa tries to teach her the ropes of the oldest profession of them all!

embedding_text:
Title: The Novices

Original Title: Les Novices

Overview: Sister Agnès runs away from her convent in Brittany and seeks refuge in Paris with prostitute Mona Lisa. With absolutely no qualifications, the young novice has a hard job finding work, so Mona Lisa tries to teach her the ropes of the oldest profession of them all!

Genres: Comedy, Drama

Production Companies: Les Films La Boétie, Rizzoli Film

Production Countries: France, Italy

Spoken Languages: French
